faqs.q: Does Dragon Professional 16 require an internet connection to use?
faqs.a: No. After installation and activation, Dragon Professional 16 operates without an internet connection. An internet connection is required only for the initial download and product activation.

faqs.q: How many PCs can I install Dragon Professional 16 on?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 is licensed per user and can be activated on up to 2 Windows PCs under a single licence.

faqs.q: Can Dragon Professional 16 transcribe meeting recordings?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 can transcribe audio files containing a single speaker. It is not designed for multi-speaker conversations, interviews, or meetings. Supported formats include MP3, WAV, WMA, DS2, and DSS.

faqs.q: Is this a subscription or a one-time purchase?
faqs.a: This is a perpetual licence - a one-time purchase. You pay once and own the software permanently with no annual renewal fees.

faqs.q: How does the subscription licence work?
faqs.a: The subscription licence is issued as a username and password rather than a traditional licence key. Activation after purchase can take up to 24 hours. The subscription auto-renews annually at $695 AUD inc GST.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the $695 auto-recurring and $795 one-off annual?
faqs.a: The $695 price applies when you set up automatic annual renewal - you save $100 per year compared to the $795 one-off annual option. Both give you the same full Dragon Professional 16 feature set with unlimited PC installs.

faqs.q: Can I install the subscription on multiple computers?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike the perpetual licence which allows 2 activations, the subscription licence can be installed on as many Windows PCs as you need.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not renew?
faqs.a: If you cancel before the annual renewal date, the licence expires and Dragon Professional will stop functioning. Your user profiles and custom vocabulary are stored locally and will not be deleted.

faqs.q: Is the subscription cheaper long-term than the perpetual licence?
faqs.a: Over 3 years, the perpetual licence ($994 once) costs less than 3 annual auto-recurring subscriptions ($695 x 3 = $2,085). The subscription suits users who want flexible multi-PC deployment, prefer annual billing, or want to avoid a higher upfront cost.

faqs.q: What is the Nuance Management Centre?
faqs.a: The Nuance Management Centre (NMC) is a server-based administration tool for IT teams to centrally manage Dragon Professional Group deployments - including assigning licences, managing user profiles, distributing custom vocabulary and commands, and monitoring usage across the organisation.

faqs.q: Does Dragon Professional Group support Single Sign-On?
faqs.a: Yes. Dragon Professional Group supports Active Directory authentication and native NMC authentication. Single sign-on via Windows credentials is supported in managed environments.

faqs.q: Can Dragon Professional Group be deployed on Citrix or Remote Desktop?
faqs.a: Yes. Dragon Professional Group supports Citrix and Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) deployments. Specific configuration requirements apply - contact our team for guidance on your environment.

faqs.q: What are the security considerations for enterprise deployment?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional Group communicates with NMC via TLS 1.2. Note that Dragon dictation recording files (DRA files) are not encrypted and should be stored with appropriate security controls. Consult the enterprise installation guide for full security guidance.

faqs.q: Is Dragon Professional 16 available for Mac?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 is a Windows-only product (Windows 10 and Windows 11). There is no Mac version of Dragon Professional 16. Nuance discontinued Dragon for Mac.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Dragon Professional 16 and Dragon Professional Anywhere?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 is a locally installed Windows application that can operate offline after activation. Dragon Professional Anywhere is a cloud-native product that requires an internet connection. Dragon Professional 16 is preferred where data handling requirements or intermittent connectivity are a concern.

faqs.q: Can Dragon Professional 16 transcribe meetings or multi-speaker recordings?
faqs.a: No. Dragon Professional 16 is designed for single-speaker audio only. It will not reliably transcribe multi-speaker conversations, interviews, or meeting recordings. Supported formats for single-speaker transcription include MP3, WAV, WMA, DS2, and DSS.

faqs.q: Does Dragon Professional 16 work with Microsoft Teams?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 includes support for dictating into Microsoft Teams. Some advanced voice commands may have limitations in Teams Home edition. Refer to the Dragon Professional 16 release notes for current Teams compatibility details.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial available?
faqs.a: A 15-day trial is available. Contact Voice Recognition Australia to arrange trial access along with local onboarding support.

faqs.q: Which microphone should I use with Dragon Professional 16?
faqs.a: Dragon Professional 16 works with a range of USB and 3.5mm microphones. Apple AirPods are not supported for dictation. A dedicated dictation microphone or USB headset generally provides the best accuracy. Contact our team for microphone recommendations.
